provenance: Real git output, captured 2026-09-30 by the M6-P3 fix round 4 implementer with a recording script (delivery/work-history/m6-p3.md, fix round 4, capture section), for what src/pool.ts reads from `git worktree list --porcelain` when destroy decides whether another worktree holds the task branch. git 2.34.1 is the packaged git of Ubuntu 22.04 (git_2.34.1-1ubuntu1.17_amd64.deb from archive.ubuntu.com, sha256 8794fcf2c4606c445df0db3dc963c8fb852772208bfb12727a12717c03767af7), extracted into a scratch directory and run through a wrapper, never installed; git 2.43.0 is the container git. Every run had LC_ALL=C, as src/pool.ts runGit pins it. Cases: z-unknown-switch, git 2.34.1 refusing `-z` on a healthy repository (the option arrived in git 2.36); newline-listing-newline-path, git 2.34.1 listing a repository with a worktree whose path holds a newline and a lock reason that holds one, showing that the reason is C-quoted onto one line and the path is not; listing-fails-bad-config, both gits failing the listing, with and without -z, in a repository whose .git/config ends in the malformed line `[core`. Substitutions, the only bytes rewritten: in newline-listing-newline-path the scratch directory is spelled <tmp> and each commit sha <sha>. JSON escapes newlines as \n, so this file is ASCII. test/pool.test.ts replays the z-unknown-switch and listing-fails-bad-config stderr and exit through a git stub on PATH, because no CI runner carries a git older than 2.36.
